hints.concept: Think about what the last valid index of an array should be.
hints.guidance: An array with length n usually has valid indexes from 0 up to n - 1.
hints.targeted: Check whether this loop condition should stop before the array length instead of including the length value.

hints.concept: A condition should normally check a value rather than change it.
hints.guidance: Look at the operator inside this condition and decide whether it is comparing two values.
hints.targeted: Check whether the condition uses assignment where a comparison was intended.

hints.concept: Array length tells you how many items exist, not the last valid position.
hints.guidance: Compare the number of elements with the final usable index.
hints.targeted: Check whether the array length is being used directly as an index.
